Vote tower logic, lockout checks, serialization, restore, and vote transaction generation.

# Purpose
This C file implements the vote tower logic used by a validator. It manages the local tower state, which stores vote slots and confirmation counts, and it applies the rules that decide when a new vote is allowed, when votes expire, when the validator can switch forks, and when the tower must reset to a new root or head slot. The main functions are [`fd_tower_vote_slot`](<#fd_tower_vote_slot>), [`fd_tower_vote`](<#fd_tower_vote>), [`fd_tower_lockout_check`](<#fd_tower_lockout_check>), [`fd_tower_switch_check`](<#fd_tower_switch_check>), [`fd_tower_threshold_check`](<#fd_tower_threshold_check>), and [`fd_tower_reset_slot`](<#fd_tower_reset_slot>). These functions use the `fd_ghost` fork tree and epoch stake data to check lockout safety and stake thresholds before a vote is made.

The file also provides support for tower state persistence and transaction generation. It can serialize and deserialize tower state with [`fd_tower_serialize`](<#fd_tower_serialize>), [`fd_tower_deserialize`](<#fd_tower_deserialize>), [`fd_tower_checkpt`](<#fd_tower_checkpt>), and [`fd_tower_restore`](<#fd_tower_restore>), and it can convert tower state into a vote transaction with [`fd_tower_to_vote_txn`](<#fd_tower_to_vote_txn>). In addition, it includes helper functions for tower creation and lifetime control, state verification with [`fd_tower_verify`](<#fd_tower_verify>), debug printing with [`fd_tower_print`](<#fd_tower_print>), and reconstruction of tower state from vote account data with [`fd_tower_from_vote_acc_data`](<#fd_tower_from_vote_acc_data>).
